title: Why it sucks being a Man City fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Man City fan!
It starts when you're five. Ninety-three minutes, twenty seconds. Agüero scores. You win the league! You think football is always like this. Your dad cries for a week.
Age eight. Your dad tells you about the third division. A play-off final against Gillingham. You think he's making it up.
Age twelve. You win every trophy in England. Your friends call you a glory hunter. You're twelve. You live in Manchester.
Age fourteen. Your first Champions League final! You lose to Chelsea. Your friends laugh for a whole year.
Age sixteen. You finally win the Champions League! The treble! Your friends say: "Bought it." You say: "Still counts."
Age seventeen. Four league titles in a row. Historic! Your friends say: "Boring."
That's the thing about being a City fan. When you win, it's boring. When you lose, it's a party. For everyone else.
But your dad remembers Gillingham. So he's never bored.
Tag a City fan who's not a glory hunter. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
